subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the sectors representing the shares of the number of electric buses manufactured in each of 7 different colours in a given year in terms of the central angles (in degrees) with respect to the total number of buses manufactured during that year of all the 7 colours taken together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6edefe6905d3b80d3d048d1e55905a78700989a3292fbb9c9775f9d9128db21.png] 

What is the difference in the percentage shares of buses of C4 and C6? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]
solution:
**Calculation:**

The difference in the percentage shares of buses of C4 and C6 = 48 - 18

⇒ 30°

Difference in % = (30/360) × 100

⇒ 8.33%

**∴ The required answer is 8.33%.**
